distinguishing_features: Uses an active pneumatic/hydraulic actuator rather than passive software inference from pressure/flow telemetry.
Mechanically modulates flange/gasket geometry by cyclic elastic deformation instead of merely detecting leakage.
Applies preload synchronized with pump/flow state to counter contact-stress relaxation.
Requires flange/housing hardware modification such as slots or external clamping to permit deformation.
parsed.objective_technical_problem: How to preserve vacuum sealing under time-dependent loss of contact stress and gas transport through or along the seal during operation.
parsed.viable_reason: Cyclic flange deformation may temporarily raise interface contact stress, but it does not block molecular outgassing/permeation through the seal and the proposed 0.1–0.5 mm flexing risks fatigue/fretting, so the mechanism is not sound as written.
parsed.non_obvious_reason: Prior art 3 only infers gasket leakage from pressure/flow data and gives no teaching or motivation to add cyclic active flange deformation, so the dynamic preload mechanism is not an obvious routine variation.
